limitations: Family status guides remediation and cannot be aggregated into an accuracy or conformance percentage.
A family can be reviewed while every member remains unresolved in the per-surface manifest.
Product usage is a static source snapshot, not telemetry or proof that a path executed in production.
review_boundary: Structural family review against the GAP-007 audit, current inventory ownership, documentation leads, test leads, response contracts, and product usage. Reviewed does not mean conformant, numerically validated, or release verified.
